name: BB2025 Default
description: Baseline BB2025 constraints with the owner's default Skill-Point costing. Intended as the layer other packages extend/override.
_notes: skillPointBudget 0 means 'no added skills' by default; real tournaments override it (see lustrian-superleague.example.json).
Costing model: costSP(skill) = (secondary ? primaryCostSP*secondaryMultiplier : primaryCostSP) + (eliteSkills.includes(skill) ? eliteSurchargeSP : 0), unless overridden by skillCostSP[skill].
Set secondaryCostSP instead of secondaryMultiplier to price secondaries as a flat value.
